Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 27 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel/You.com keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/DeepSeek (official + native tools/search)/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao with key; OpenAI/Gemini/Claude model built…
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
Session archive management for DSH Web: centralized inventory, batch archive/restore, physical delete with family cascade, and optional auto-archive / auto-cleanup policies.
Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能与技能包（包目录一键安装/可选/自动装齐）、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口）、左栏「工作台」面板；插件装前宿主兼容预检；官方桌面端「关于」页自升级修复：分离进程 pnpm 通道绕开宿主 already-installed 死路（Windows 适配），附「让 AI 代升级」一句话引导
CANNBot Harness: Ascend development workbench with independently versioned workflow packages

DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
Create Blender product scenes in DSH with editable recipes, model imports, previews and PNG/MP4 delivery; includes workbench and agent configuration.

DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, or WSL on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render the session brief — the todo list (the `todos` projection board) plus the artifact list (a live produced-files feed, codeplan artifacts marked) — as a summary tab in the right sidebar, and shadow the official composer-band todo panel so the board…

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move,  (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
DSH Web 插件：会话管家（合并包）—— 会话历史文件（归档浏览与清理）与健康检查（体检 → 处方 → 出院），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索索引（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出）。不碰会话日志、只做可逆处置。
One plugin for a calmer DeepSeek Harness: reading view + message rail + smart history loading, for Harness 0.1.0-0.2.1 (all rc).
LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions and symbols over real language servers. Hot-mountable from dshmarket.
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
Community plugin index data source for the dsh web ecosystem: community.json is the single source of the Workshop store plugin list and the dsh-market.com plugin manifest.
External dsh web GUI plugin: a blank-session git branch selector + Git graph, with real host-side git operations and guards, as a dsh profile bundle
Workshop browser card: browse skins, pets and community plugins from dsh-market.com and install them in the GUI (assets into the DSH home directories, plugins through the optional plugin manager).
DSH Web GUI plugin for editing a text-only user message, forking at its preceding event boundary, and resending on the new branch.

Community agent-preset manager: the Workshop's Presets panel and the host library that installs, declares, disables and uninstalls presets downloaded from dsh-market.com, keeping a downloaded composition inert until the plugin declares it to the agent-preset registry.
DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), enable or disable, create and delete, in a web GUI panel.
Host-authoritative task board for the DSH Web GUI with real session execution, Host cron scheduling, and optional cross-platform idle-sleep protection; mounted without DSH source changes.
External provider extension for the dsh Web GUI task board that synchronizes GitHub Issues into the board; shipped as a dsh profile bundle with no DSH source changes.
Web UI plugin group for the dsh settings page: one first-level settings section that hosts the dsh-web family plugins' enable switches and configuration forms.

LiangShen (梁神) agent preset plus its composer lever for the dsh web GUI. The host half declares the bundled preset to the harness's agent-preset registry at activation (declare = enabled), so the preset is selectable for new sessions without writing anything into the harness home; the preset keeps …
Multi-pet companion plugin for the dsh web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity, with per-pet naming, petting/feeding interactions and an affinity score

Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json, import from ~/.ssh/config), a persistent ssh2 connection pool with jump-host support, exec / PTY web terminal / SFTP transfer / local port-forward tunnels / cluster execution, plus agent tools (ssh_list, ssh_exec, ss…

Puts the dsh Web GUI task board on the remote surface: the host half binds the board's capability face to the dsh-remote-bridge extension seam, so a paired phone reads the same ledger (snapshot, acceptance options, idempotent actions, revision events) through the host's own gates.

Self-update plugin for the dsh web GUI: probes npm for newer family releases and runs the owning profile's pnpm update in place, from a sidebar trigger beside the settings seat with a release-notes panel
Usage statistics plugin for the dsh web GUI: per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection plus a live token usage ledger, with a compact price glance card above the sidebar's Settings row
DSH Web UI 全家桶聚合插件：一键安装全部功能插件（task-board / git-graph / pet / web-ui-settings / skin-center / community-plugins / compat shim）。compat 桥接层已并入本包（src/client），无需独立 compat npm 包。
Pinned private bash for Windows x64 DSH sessions: one persistent bash process per session behind the win_bash tool, carrying a digested Git for Windows MinGit payload and no PATH fallback.

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake turns with tombstone compaction; ships a we…
Appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, background image, transparency and blur over the --dsw-* token system

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
DSH Archive Manager - preview, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
DeepSeek Harness 记忆系统(单包单入口):JSONL 存储 + 本地向量检索(BGE-M3)+ 五个模型工具 + 自动召回注入 + 管理面板。
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
PTC-Lite agent preset, its prompt trim, and its terse tool results
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness: native web_search via the Anthropic-compatible Messages API, with GLM response-format translation.
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.

dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed loop on RDB persistence, with the conversatio…
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.
Right-docked live browser view for the DSH Web GUI: a CDP-driven Chromium the agent operates, a screencast panel the user watches, and screenshots attached to every tool result.

Update checking for the dsh web GUI's official Plugins page: compares installed plugins against the version their registry source serves, gates the update on the DSH runtime minimum the release declares, and drives the update through the official installer channel or this package's loopback CLI gat…
DSH web GUI plugin: sidebar-foot Session ID panel listing every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only; no source changes).

DSH web GUI language pack plugin: registers the Русский language into the locale catalog and centrally carries the ru dictionaries for every family plugin namespace (missing keys fall back to English through the SDK chain).
DSH skill center: browse by region, install from zip, manage (enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore, search).
